result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by eliminating all minimum purchase, take-or-pay, and volume commitments and limiting payment to ordered services and actual usage. The added confirmation that existing termination and reduction rights remain unaffected appropriately removes the original restriction without altering unrelated commercial terms. The clause is concise and professionally drafted, though using “or” rather than “and” between ordered services and incurred usage could make the alternative payment bases slightly clearer.
